requirement_text: Ingest p95 ≤ 300 ms at 20 rps for 5 min; 0 unexpected 5xx

dataset.message_id_uniqueness: run_id + VU + iteration; one ingest per iteration

reproduction: dotnet ef database update --project backend/src/Postern.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/Postern.Api
caveats: Measured against the local Docker Compose Development stack, not production; QR2.3 CPU evidence remains a separate Cloudflare-sourced record.
Ingest is best-effort async with a 202/200 response; the scenario asserts the HTTP path latency and success rate, not downstream forwarding throughput.

The k6 --summary-export JSON serialises threshold booleans as false even on a passing run; PASS is determined from the console threshold report (all ✓) and k6 exit code 0. The metric values above are taken from the exported summary.
